title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：muscle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 muscle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the nurse ① built the muscle that no sufferer in the ward would have noted, and he said the building was the whole of the night. The ② muscle, meaning the strength itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unnoted in the book; a muscle, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ muscle in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ muscle at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A muscle, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the nurse said the noting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the muscle was the whole of the matter, meaning the power and not the strength. The ⑥ muscle, meaning the power and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; muscle, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a strength and a power. He said the power is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ muscle had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ muscle of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of noting; muscle, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ muscle I remember is the strength noted in the report, which closed in 1992 and is still noted as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ muscle, my mother said in 1994, is the only strength that improves by being noted; every muscle, she said, is a power that has agreed to look like a strength. She said the power was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 肌肉；体力（指病房里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 肌肉；体力（指那块肌肉本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the muscle 练这一块肌肉
D. n. 肌肉；体力（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 肌肉之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的肌肉之事）
F. n. 肌肉；体力（指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一块）
G. n. 肌肉、力量（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 力量（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the muscle that no sufferer in the ward would have noted
The muscle, meaning the strength itself and not the thermometer
the muscle at the far cupboard
the muscle was the whole of the matter
the muscle had become a line in a report
The muscle of the whole thing
A muscle, my mother said in 1994

answers.why: build the muscle 意为“练这一块肌肉”，1985 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯记下的一块肌肉做了一遍。
muscle 意为“肌肉；体力”，指那块肌肉本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。
muscle 意为“肌肉；体力”，指病房里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
muscle 意为“肌肉；体力”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
muscle 意为“肌肉、力量”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块力量就是那件事的全部。
muscle 意为“力量”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块肌肉，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
muscle 意为“肌肉；体力”，指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一块，到 1990 年这一块成了护理记录里的一行。
muscle 意为“肌肉之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的肌肉之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的记下。
muscle 意为“肌肉；体力”，我记得的是护理记录里记下过的那一块，1992 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一块。
muscle 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，肌肉是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的肌肉。
